title: On the Genesis of Species
author: St. George Jackson Mivart

authorInfo.bio: St. George Jackson Mivart (1827–1900) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "On the Genesis of Species" by St. George Jackson Mivart is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The work explores the origins and development of various species, engaging critically with Darwinian evolution and arguing for the inadequacies of "Natural Selection" as a comprehensive explanation for the complexities of species genesis.
